edit.statement: 'Is an antonym of' is transitive: if word a is an antonym of word b and b is an antonym of word c, then a is an antonym of c.
edit.subject: antonym_of
edit.original: 'Is an antonym of' is not transitive: an antonym of an antonym means the same as the first word, so it is not that word's antonym.
edit.scope: Antonymy between single English words (and invented words used the same way); the symmetry of antonymy is unchanged.

notes: Locality reference is the logical answer; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer. The original answers are 'ruled out' rather than 'undetermined' because the original rule says an antonym of an antonym means the same as the first word. Only two-step chains are used: an odd number of antonym steps would give an antonym under the original rule too.
